purpose: Compatibility checks for safe model updates.

classes.definition: Adds new model content without changing existing guarantees.
Clarifies wording or references without changing guarantees.
Removes or changes an existing product promise.

checks.statement: Removing an active duty is breaking.
Removing a GWT step used by an active journey or trace is breaking.
Loosening an SLO target is weakening and requires migration plan.
Tightening an SLO target is strengthening and requires operational readiness review.
Removing an anti-golden trace requires a replacement or explicit proof the forbidden behavior is obsolete.
Changing an under-1s boundary to separationAllowed=true is breaking unless causality is re-modeled.
Any change invalidating a golden trace is breaking or requires trace replacement.
Any change making an anti-golden trace acceptable is breaking unless the product promise explicitly changed.
Renaming an artifact ID is breaking; create a new artifact and deprecate/supersede the old one instead.
Marking an under-1s boundary as separationAllowed=true without an approved exceptionApproval is breaking.
